mapper.select: SELECT f.fan_id AS fanId, f.first_name AS firstName, f.last_name AS lastName, f.email AS email, f.phone_number AS phoneNumber, f.occupation AS occupation, p.stand_id AS standId, r.seat_id AS seatId FROM StadiumRewardSystem.Reward r JOIN StadiumRewardSystem.Fan f ON r.fan_id = f.fan_id JOIN StadiumRewardSystem.Preference p ON p.fan_id = f.fan_id ORDER BY p.stand_id ASC;
